notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the stats screen were shown over gameplay in endless mode.
Capped endless items at 14.
Got some sleep and had a nice breakfast.

notes.title: Patch Notes v 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved visuals. This causes the game to now use a loading screen. The first level loaded at the start of a new game session will take longer than the others (the loading may appear to freeze, but that is normal).
[*] Improved speed buttons.
[*] Changed tower stats visuals at the end of the game to a list (instead of displaying your tower cards).
[*] Separated control panel from settings, added separate button.
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
Added 5 new maps and reworked the Mountain Pass level.
Stars required to unlock levels are changed to reflect this.
Reworked the Mountain Pass level, should no longer be insanely difficult.

[b]Factions[/b]
Warlock Bonus reworked. Now gives +1/2/3 to all DoT triggered for each Warlock in play. Explanation: If a tower deals 3 DoT normally it would trigger 1 damage 3 times. With +1 DoT trigger it will trigger 2 damage (1 base+1 bonus) then 1 damage (1 base + 0 bonus, because no remainder) for a total of the 3 damage. 

[b]Towers[/b]
Added Fireland Hut: Reptan/Magic tower throwing fireballs.

[u]Common[/u]
Swamp Hut: No longer slows. Changed attack speed scaling from 6/6/6 to 6/9/14. 
Dark Knights: Changed attack speed scaling from 2/2/4 to 2/4/6.

[u]Rare[/u]
Thieves Guild: Changed attack speed scaling from 4/5/6 to 6/8/10. 
Forest Ruins: Attack speed scaling 3/3/3 to 3/4/5. Damage scaling 2/3/5 to 3/5/9. 
Flamethrower: Changed attack speed scaling from 2/2/2 to 2/3/4.
Tar Pit: Changed effect scaling from 50/60/70 to 50/60/80.
Plague Totem: Changed damage scaling from 1/2/3 to 1/2/4. 
Reptan Fight Pits: Changed attack speed scaling from 2/3/4 to 2/4/6 

[u]Epic[/u]
Elven Warglaives: Changed damage scaling from 3/4/5 to 3/5/8. 

[u]Legendary[/u]
Heart of the Forest: Changed damage scaling from 2/4/6 to 4/8/10. 
Gattling Crossbows: Changed damage scaling from 5/5/7 to 3/4/5.
Reptan Hive: Changed attack speed scaling from 2/3/4 to 2/2/2. Damage scaling from 5/5/5 to 8/12/15.

[b]Items[/b]
Items have been changed to make them more engaging and interesting. 
Visual overhaul.

[u]New Items[/u]
Replaced Dark Force with Impending Darkness: Giving +1 dot triggers.
Added Tax Policy: Interest cap +1.
Added Mountain Lords: Dwarves deals +30% damage if gaining maximum interest.
Added Venomclaw: Reptans has a 10% chance to deal double damage to enemies with a DoT.
Added Throwing Dagger: Assassins has a 10% chance to throw a piercing dagger dealing 1 damage.
Added Walking Bomb: DoT has a 10% chance on kill to unleash the remaining DoT as AoE damage.
Added Explosive Hits: Siegeworks has a 10% chance to create an AoE dealing 1 damage on hit.
Added Whirlwind: Infantry has a 10% chance on attack to summon a whirlwind dealing AoE damage.
Added Arcane Echo: Magic towers has a 10% chance to attack twice.

[u]Reworked[/u]
Overcharge: Proc chance changed from 10% to 30%.
Rupture: Old effect: Crits apply a DoT dealing 3 damage. New effect: Crits have a 30% chance to apply a DoT dealing equal damage.
Reptan Reflexes renamed to Reptan Rage and effect is changed from 30% to 15% attack speed.
Shared Secrets: Changed from rare to epic.
Haste: Changed from rare to epic.
Deadly Strikes: Changed from rare to epic.
Renamed Walking Bomb to Living Curse.

[b]Bugs[/b]
Shop rarity chances should now work properly (was giving common cards instead of rares).
Tower stats should no longer display ugly decimals (ex. 7.00).
Clicking the settings button will now pause the game.

notes.title: The Revenant Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.5 of Broken Banners features exciting new content and targets issues you, the players have brought to our attention. 

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Revenant, a brand new, powerful enemy
[*] 6 New Items, such as "Execute" allowing Infantry to instantly kill enemies below 15% HP
[*] Additional balancing to towers and waves
[*] Waves now has more variety with strong single enemies and multiple weak enemies
[*] Bug fixes and improvements to the game
[/list]

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Added the Revenant enemy to the game.
[*] Added 6 more items to the game.
[*] A new visual scaling method which should improve image quality (feedback needed).
[*] In windowed mode, you can now draw the corners of the screen to scale the game to your need.
[*] Fixed a bug with toggling damage numbers.
[*] Fixed a bug causing a crash in endless mode when the player looses.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could upgrade towers in the end screen.
[*] The Siegework faction bonus now shows the correct tooltip.
[*] Made small changes to waves.
[*] Improved tower's tier 2 and 3 for most towers.
[*] Throwing Axes are now also a Siegework.
[*] The Dwarven Sniper is now also an Archer.
[*] The Elven Warglaives is now also an Archer.
[*] The Elven City is no longer a Siegework.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Watch Post would wrongly Penetrate.
[*] The base speed of DoT's has been nerfed.
[*] Minor visual enhancements and fixes.
[*] Minor optimization enhancements.
[/list]

Regarding the Infantry faction bonus:
Some of you have given feedback of this bonus not working properly. I would like to assure you that it is working as intended. Damage numbers are rounded to not clutter the screen, so this bonus is most noticable on higher damage towers.

This update was done quickly to get important issues fixed, there will be more updates with fixes to less pressing issues.
We are very excited to hear all the positive feedback from you all, and we will continue to improve the game based on your feedback!
